EMPLOYMENT TRIBUNALS
Case Number: 6014827/2026

Claimant: Ms Rosalind Penhaligon
Respondent: Mallowmere Care Homes Limited

Heard at: Manchester Employment Tribunal
On: 9th day of September 2026
Before: Employment Judge Okereke

JUDGMENT

1. The claimant, Ms Penhaligon, was employed as a senior carer from 1 October 2021 until her dismissal on 30 May 2026.

2. Her address at the time of the claim was 41 Oakhanger Avenue, Stockport SK4 3RJ.

3. The respondent shall pay the claimant compensation of £18,250 for unfair dismissal.

4. Any appeal lies to the Employment Appeal Tribunal.

5. The claim was first listed before the Employment Tribunal sitting at Liverpool and was transferred on 2 June 2026.

6. Correspondence for the respondent should be sent to Level 2, 7 Linnet Court, Stockport SK4 2BW, United Kingdom.
